intent: Cross the brightest June morning, a flower valley and sunlit climb to a huge midsummer plateau and golden-evening horizon. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The midsummer morning
sections.lesson: Begin beneath the longest day’s sky. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

signs.text:
The midsummer morning
The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

sections.name: The flower valley
sections.lesson: Follow the wide valley’s bellflower arcs. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

signs.text:
The flower valley
The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

sections.name: The sunlit hill
sections.lesson: Climb from flowers into the long light. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

signs.text:
The sunlit hill
The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

sections.name: The midsummer plateau
sections.lesson: A broad high crossing under an enormous sky. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

signs.text:
The midsummer plateau
The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

sections.name: The golden-evening horizon
sections.lesson: Keep moving into the warm evening light. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

signs.text:
The golden-evening horizon
The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.
